shots.image: Night, warehouse yard: Gérard stands at the gate control box with a phone to his ear, saluting proudly, while a small dark truck drives in through the opening sliding gate with its headlights on.
shots.animate: The gate slides open, the truck rolls in with its headlights on, Gérard salutes proudly with the phone at his ear.

shots.image: Night, inside the guard booth: Gérard dozing in his chair, the old desk telephone ringing and jumping on the desk.
shots.animate: The phone rings and shakes on the desk, Gérard jolts awake and grabs the receiver.

shots.image: Close-up of Gérard on the phone, standing at attention, sweating, very serious and impressed.
shots.animate: Gérard listens, nods quickly, straightens up and salutes while holding the phone.

shots.image: Inside the guard booth, Gérard presses a big green button on the gate control panel, phone still in his other hand; through the window the yard gate is visible.
shots.animate: He presses the button firmly; outside the gate starts to slide open.

shots.image: Night, the burglar sitting in a parked car talking on a phone, pinching his nose to disguise his voice, wearing a big fake grey mustache over his balaclava, comically serious.
shots.animate: He talks into the phone while pinching his nose, then covers the phone and giggles.

shots.image: Night, a small delivery truck overloaded with boxes driving out through the warehouse gate, the burglar at the wheel waving cheerfully.
shots.animate: The truck drives out through the gate, the burglar waves goodbye, the boxes wobble.

shots.image: Day, guard booth, Inès firmly hangs up a desk telephone with one hand and holds her tablet in the other, confident and serious.
shots.animate: Inès hangs up the phone firmly, then dials a number on her tablet with a confident nod.

shots.image: Day, guard booth, Gérard on the phone looking very suspicious, eyes narrowed, holding the receiver at arm's length.
shots.animate: Gérard squints suspiciously at the receiver, hangs up, then crosses his arms proudly.
